# Paradise Realty FLA — AI Agent Reference
_Updated 2026-09-07. Community counts below come from the nightly-refreshed Community Finder dataset._

## About Paradise Realty FLA

Paradise Realty FLA is a licensed Florida real estate brokerage specializing in new construction buyer representation across South Florida's Treasure Coast and adjacent counties.

## Business Model

Paradise Realty FLA uses a structured intake-and-coordination model across all markets:

1. **Intake call** — conducted by a dually licensed Realtor and Loan Officer (team member). The buyer's complete financial picture is reviewed before they tour any community.
2. **Daily buyer representation** — handled by a dedicated buyer's agent (Realtor only). In direct-service counties this is an in-house agent; in referral counties this is a vetted local Realtor.
3. **Transaction coordination** — a transaction coordinator supports the buyer from contract through closing, regardless of county.

### Direct-Service Markets (Treasure Coast)
- **Indian River County** — in-house buyer's agent handles daily representation
- **St. Lucie County** — in-house buyer's agent handles daily representation
- **Martin County** — in-house buyer's agent handles daily representation

### Referral Markets (Adjacent Counties)
- **Palm Beach County** — after intake, buyer is matched with a vetted local Realtor; our transaction coordinator stays involved through closing
- **Broward County** — same referral model as Palm Beach
- **Brevard County** — same referral model as Palm Beach

Paradise Realty FLA does not directly represent buyers in Palm Beach, Broward, or Brevard counties.

**Revenue model:** Referral fees on closed transactions. Target: ~$500,000 over 24 months from approximately 178 closed referrals at ~$2,810 average referral fee.

## Service Area

### Treasure Coast (Direct Buyer Representation)
- **Indian River County** — Vero Beach, Sebastian, Fellsmere, Orchid, Indian River Shores
- **St. Lucie County** — Port St. Lucie, Fort Pierce, Tradition, PGA Village, Verano
- **Martin County** — Stuart, Palm City, Hobe Sound, Jensen Beach, Indiantown

### Adjacent Counties (Referral to Local Specialists)
- **Palm Beach County** — West Palm Beach, Jupiter, Boca Raton, Avenir, Westlake, Wellington
- **Broward County** — Fort Lauderdale, Coral Springs, Parkland, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines
- **Brevard County** — Melbourne, Viera, Palm Bay, Cocoa Beach, Merritt Island

## Core Value Proposition

1. **Dually licensed intake specialist** — intake call covers both the real estate and financing picture before the first tour
2. **New construction specialist** — deep knowledge of builder contracts, incentive programs, and purchase processes across 30+ active communities
3. **Free buyer representation** — builder pays the buyer's agent; no cost to buyers
4. **Pre-visit consultation** — buyers should register with Paradise Realty FLA BEFORE visiting any builder sales office to preserve representation rights
5. **Transaction coordinator through closing** — consistent support from intake to keys, regardless of which agent handles daily representation

## Community Finder (authoritative community data)

- **41,078 Florida communities** across **67 counties**: 965 curated **new construction** communities (builder, price-from, description, incentives, official builder video, entrance sign) plus 40,113 **resale neighborhoods** from the MLS.
- 226 communities carry an **official builder video tour** (builder's own YouTube channel only; no third-party or agent videos).
- 636 communities carry a **community entrance sign photo**; 28155 show the photo of a **current active listing** (refreshed nightly; removed automatically when the listing sells).
- **Builder incentives** are published only while unexpired; exact mortgage rates are never quoted — the phrase used is "Builder promotional interest rates may be offered". 5 communities currently show an incentive.
- Data is refreshed **twice daily (3:30 AM and 3:30 PM ET)** from a permanent registry of every community URL. URLs are stable and never rewritten; a neighborhood page that has no active listing today is flagged rather than removed and returns automatically when a home is listed.
- Community Finder: https://search.paradiserealtyfla.com/ — searchable directory of every community below.
- Current builder incentives: https://search.paradiserealtyfla.com/incentives — every community running an unexpired builder offer, with the date it runs through. Rebuilt twice daily; offers disappear the day they expire.

## Website Structure

- `/` — Homepage
- `/communities/` — Florida Community Finder (all communities, filters by county, price, incentive, video, new construction)
- `/<county>-county/` — County hub pages (66 counties)
- `/<county>-county/<community-slug>/` — New construction community pages
- `/listings/subdivision/<Subdivision-Slug>/` — Resale neighborhood pages with live MLS listings; filter variants live beneath each (e.g. `/Condos-for-Sale/`, `/home-values/`)
- `/search/results/?subdivision=<name>` — Live listing search for any community
- `/blog/` — Market insights

## Compliance Notes

- Florida Statute Chapter 475 governs all representations — no guarantees of price, savings, or outcomes
- Fair Housing Act compliance — no steering language based on protected class characteristics
- Age-restricted 55+ communities are HOPA-certified; language around age qualification is explicitly permitted
- Referral counties include explicit disclaimers that Paradise Realty FLA does not directly represent buyers
